scope: Limits of environment attribution for the original full rank-six replay; not a mathematical PASS receipt

isolated_diagnostic_versions: Recorded separately in the individual receipts; first-system failures were reproduced under explicitly observed Flint 0.8.0 and 0.9.0. Complete selected replays used the Python ground-type backend.
new_orchestrator: replay_complete.py records actual requested and observed backend plus installed package versions separately for each child process. This new orchestration has not itself been executed end to end.
